lesson-intro.text: Here is the mushroom from every fairy tale, red on top with pale spots. We'll peek under the cap too. Watch where the gills go, then it's time for yours.

cap-left.text: The cap is a wide dome. From the top, curve down to the left like half a rainbow.

cap-right.text: Now the other half of the rainbow, from the top down to the right.

rim.text: Join the two ends with a long line that lifts a little in the middle.

spots.text: Three spots float on the cap. A big oval up high, then a smaller one on each side.

stem.text: The stem hangs from the middle of the rim. It widens on the way down and ends in a round foot.

underside.text: Under the rim, draw a shallow curve from each end of the cap in to the stem.

gills-left.text: Gills are short lines under the cap. Draw three on the left, fanning out like umbrella ribs.

gills-right.text: Three more on the right, fanning the other way.

cap-color.text: Color the cap red, around the spots.

cream.text: Color the three spots cream, and the underside too.

lesson-outro.text: Spots on top and gills underneath. Your mushroom belongs in a storybook.
